a394d042b25d8fb4dc985c6ccb9785fc0e491aab.title: The Fed Has Two Tools to Influence Money Market Conditions
a394d042b25d8fb4dc985c6ccb9785fc0e491aab.scrapedSnippet: The Federal Reserve’s 2022-23 tightening cycle involved the use of two monetary policy tools: changes in administrative rates and changes in the size of its balance sheet. This post highlights the results of a recent Staff Report that explores how these tools affect money market conditions. Using confidential trade-level data, we find that both tools have significant effects on the pricing of funds sourced through repo. 4b86e70c3309fb0e59f88ebb6bed60c13fbf816c.title: Bank Failures: Solvency and Liquidity
4b86e70c3309fb0e59f88ebb6bed60c13fbf816c.scrapedSnippet: Bank failures are almost always preceded by weak fundamentals. Depositor panics are rarely the root cause.
4b86e70c3309fb0e59f88ebb6bed60c13fbf816c.aiSummary: The paper argues that bank failures are primarily driven by weak underlying fundamentals rather than depositor panics. It emphasizes the role of solvency issues over sudden liquidity shocks in triggering institutional collapse.

5db402c171740647575da1108949579d3331851a.title: Expectations on Wealth Returns: Implications for Labor Supply During the Retirement Boom
5db402c171740647575da1108949579d3331851a.aiSummary: The study explores how expectations regarding wealth returns impact labor supply decisions during periods of increased retirement. It analyzes the trade-off between leisure and employment in the context of asset performance.

934eca1138cc1ddbc4e82d5be92a164d4593d1a7.title: A Closer Look at Emerging Market Resilience During Recent Shocks
934eca1138cc1ddbc4e82d5be92a164d4593d1a7.scrapedSnippet: A succession of shocks to the global economy in recent years has focused attention on the improved economic and financial resilience of emerging market economies. For some of these economies, this assessment is well-founded and highlights the fruits of deep, structural economic reforms since the 1990s. However, for a much larger universe of countries, the ability to weather shocks is still mixed and many remain vulnerable. In this post, we explore the divide between the two sets of countries and focus on the effects of recent economic shocks, including the ongoing conflict in the Middle East.
